data.long_meaning: Samser is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Hindu God Surya, meaning 'God of the Sun'. It is a powerful name that symbolizes strength, loyalty, and the sun's life-giving energy. The name Samser carries the meaning “God of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Samser usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Samser belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samser total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
